Indie devs spent a week convinced Steam had just buried them for good. Valve quietly reworked the store homepage, and one of the only reliable ways small games used to break through looked like it had been handed straight to the biggest names in gaming. Then the numbers started coming in. Here's what the new Steam actually does to the little guy, and why nobody bothered to tell the developers it was happening.
